messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable modern Space Invaders-style game with colorful visuals, health, upgradeable weapons, multiple stages, and start-menu difficulty options.

## Requirements
- At least 10–20 levels; weapon upgrades to level 10 from drops earned by killing enemies, maximum three upgrades per stage.
- Keep weapon upgrades between levels; weapon level downgrades on death.
- Difficulty selectable from the start menu.

## Decisions
- Built a standalone browser game in one `index.html`, with 15 sectors and Calm, Standard, and Intense difficulties.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive neon arcade game, keyboard/touch controls, player health, enemy formations and fire, score, upgrade drops, 15 stages, difficulty selection, pause, victory/game-over flows, and local best score.
- Checked JavaScript syntax and launched a browser smoke test; the game entered gameplay and showed Sector 01.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/starfall-game.jpg`.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If further verification is needed, test mobile layout, weapon progression, death downgrade, and level transitions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/starfall-game.jpg`: Latest gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Initial browser smoke test exposed a canvas error (`The radius provided (-0.00241077) is negative.`); star twinkle radius was clamped, and a subsequent browser run completed without page errors.

content.text:
Implemented the playable **STARFALL // Neon Uprising** game in `index.html`.

It includes 15 sectors, three difficulty settings, health and score tracking, weapon upgrades up to level 10, mobile touch controls, pause and end-game screens, and a locally saved best score. Weapon upgrades carry between sectors; death lowers the weapon level.

Verified the game enters gameplay in a browser and fixed a canvas error found during the smoke test. Changes are uncommitted.
